plot: On the night of the Wheelburg Honk Concert, Turbo's horn only goes a deep 'bwomp' ten minutes before his solo; Maestro's Truth Press squeeze, Bertha's honk lessons and Pip's blowing all fail, a mysterious 'ta-da-daaa' sounds in the dark, and Bertha's joke finally makes silent Grumpy laugh out Turbo's honk: their horns swapped in the car-wash bubbles; after swapping back Turbo shares the solo with Grumpy (lesson: sharing the spotlight makes the music bigger); then something in the sky honks back.

script.title: Turbo Lost His Honk! 📯😱 Night Concert Mystery
script.description: On the night of the Honk Concert, Turbo's horn only goes bwomp. Inspector Bolt and friends have ten minutes to find his real honk before the stars go to sleep. Sharing the spotlight makes the music bigger! Inspector Bolt #11

beats.say: HONK! Bwomp?! Why does my horn sound like a sleepy cow?
Tonight was the Wheelburg Honk Concert, under the stars.
Turbo! You play the big honk solo in ten minutes!
I can't play a solo that goes bwomp!
Maybe your horn caught a cold, Turbo?
Warm-up time, everyone! Mee-mee-mee! Honk-honk-honk!
Everyone honked to warm up. Everyone except Grumpy.
Hmph. I'm not honking tonight. Not one single honk.
Not even one, Grumpy? It's a honk concert, honey!
I said not one. My horn is on holiday.
A horn on holiday? Where does a horn even go?
Somewhere quiet. Not like here.
Then a blue car with a brown hat rolled in.
Good evening. I heard a very unusual bwomp.
Inspector! Somebody broke my honk! Listen. Bwooomp.
That is not a Turbo sound. That is a mystery.
Procedure. We go back through Turbo's whole day.
Easy! Morning, I raced. Lunch, I raced. Then... car wash!
Who else went to the car wash today?
Me! And Grumpy! We were all in the bubbles together!
Turbo didn't hear that. He was too busy bwomping.
Maybe a sneaky car stole my honk while I napped!
Nobody can steal a honk, Turbo. But a honk can get lost.
No time for car washes! Let's try the Truth Press!
A little squeeze might squish the honk back out!
Very gently, please. The press is for truth, not horns.
The press came down. Squeeze! Turbo tried his honk.
Bwomp. Bwomp-bwomp. Now I'm a flat, sleepy cow!
Ha! Sorry, Turbo. That one was very, very funny.
Grumpy almost laughed too. He shut his mouth tight. Mmmph!
Five minutes! No solo means no concert tonight!
Then Wheelburg's stars won't hear a single honk!
Don't worry, sugar! I'll teach you my honk. Big and round!
Fill your tires, open wide, and go... HOOOONK!
Fill tires, open wide... BWOMMMP.
The bwomp was so deep, the podium wobbled.
Well! That's a new sound for the music book.
Hmph. Moo.
My turn! I'll blow on your horn, like on a hot soup.
Phoooo! Phoooo! Now try!
Bwomp. Still a cow. A cooler cow, but a cow.
Then sing it instead! La-la-HONK! Like that!
La-la-bwomp. Nope. Even my singing is a cow.
Then, from the dark, came a tiny sound. Ta-da-daaa!
That's MY honk! Somebody is playing my honk!
That was me. I mean, my trumpet. I think.
You think? You don't have a trumpet, Maestro.
Oh dear. Then I don't know who it was!
Everybody, quiet please. Not a peep. Let's listen.
Wheelburg went very still. Only the crickets sang.
I hear something breathing. Very carefully. Over there.
Don't look at me. I'm just being grumpy. Quietly.
Grumpy, would you honk once for us? Just one tiny honk?
No. Absolutely not. My horn is on holiday, remember?
Two minutes! If we don't start, the stars will go to sleep!
Please, everyone! I need my honk for the solo!
Bolt smiled. He had a very clever idea.
Bertha, I believe you know the funniest joke in Wheelburg.
Ooh, I do! Why did the car get a puppy?
Because it wanted a little... BARK-ing space!
Grumpy tried not to laugh. He tried very hard.
Ha... ha... HA... TA-DA-DAAA!
Grumpy! You took my honk?
I didn't take it! It came out of the bubbles on me!
Of course. The car wash. Your horns got mixed up.
Turbo got Grumpy's deep bwomp. Grumpy got Turbo's ta-da.
So that's why Grumpy didn't honk all night!
I liked it. For once, I sounded fun. Like a party.
Grumpy looked at the ground. Turbo looked at Grumpy.
One minute! Quick, back to the car wash! Swap them!
Splash! Bubbles! Scrub! And out they came again.
Testing... TA-DA-DAAA! I'm back! I'm totally back!
Bwomp. Yes. That's me again. Hmph.
Aww. Grumpy looks sad without his party honk.
Grumpy, wait. Let's play the solo together. You and me.
Together? A ta-da and a bwomp?
The fanciest ta-da needs the biggest bwomp under it!
And a one, and a two, and a HONK!
Ta-da-bwomp! Ta-da-bwomp! It was the best song Wheelburg ever heard.
Today's lesson. Sharing the spotlight makes the music bigger.
I'm still grumpy. But I'm a musical grumpy now.
And they honked under the stars until bedtime.
Then, from high in the sky, something honked back. Who was it?
